text: Grab your shovel, hunter. This... is Hoodlox!
A treasure hunt game on Robinhood Chain. One shared 3D valley, where every hunter plays together, live, right in your browser. On desktop, or on mobile.
Getting started takes seconds. Connect your wallet, pick your hero, and give them a name.
Six hunters to choose from. The Knight. The Ranger. The Mage. The Rogue. The Brute. And the Shade.
Move with W, A, S, D, or the joystick on mobile. Hold shift, or tap run, to sprint. Space to jump. And press V to switch between third and first person.
Every two hours, a new epoch begins. Twenty to thirty crates are buried across the valley, and whatever is left from the last round, disappears.
Keep your eyes open! A crate shows up as a chest, half sunk in the grass. Walk up to it, and press E to dig.
Only one hunter can dig a crate at a time. No fighting, no stealing. Whoever claims it first, keeps it.

Your tool decides how fast you dig. The Rusty Shovel is free, and takes sixty seconds. The Iron Pickaxe digs in thirty, for zero point one percent of supply. And the Golden Drill? Just fifteen seconds, for zero point two percent. All paid in Hoodle.
Every crate hides a chest, in five rarities. Common. Uncommon. Rare. Epic. And the one everybody wants... Legendary!
Open your chests from the inventory, and see what you got.
The rewards are real. Eth, Hoodle, and tokenized stocks like Tesla, Nvidia, Apple, and the S and P 500. Every epoch has its own pool, and rarer chests take a bigger share of it.
Ready to cash out? Hit Redeem, and your rewards go straight to your wallet, as on-chain transfers anyone can check.
Your dashboard tracks everything. Your level, your profit, the chests you found, the live pool, and the countdown to the next epoch.
Level up every five chests, climb the leaderboard, and show the whole valley who the top hunter is.
And it is fair. Crate rarities stay secret until the dig is done, dig times are checked by the server, and every payout lives on chain.
The valley is waiting. Play now, at hoodlox dot fun. Dig. Open. Earn!
